note: What a client sends while a match loads, saying how far it has got. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id the sender holds.

fields.name: percent
fields.note: How far loading has got, to 100.

fields.name: eta
fields.note: How many seconds it expects to take still.

bits.name: count
bits.note: How many times this has been reported.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client reporting.

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: Who is reporting. A client sends every bit set, which names nobody.

fields.name: percent
fields.note: How far loading has got, from zero to one hundred.

fields.name: eta
fields.note: How long the client expects still to take, in seconds.

bits.name: count
bits.note: It rises with each report, not always by one.

bits.name: ping
bits.note: Round trip time the client measures, in milliseconds.

bits.name: loaded
bits.note: Set in every report whose progress stands at one hundred, and in no other.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client reporting.

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: Who is reporting. A client sends every bit set, which names nobody.

fields.name: percent
fields.note: How far loading has got, from zero to one hundred.

fields.name: eta
fields.note: How long the client expects still to take, in seconds.

bits.name: count
bits.note: How many reports have been made.

bits.name: ping
bits.note: Round trip time the client measures, in milliseconds.

bits.name: loaded
bits.note: A client sets it only in reports whose progress stands at one hundred.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a client may leave any value here, and a server ignores it.
